**Compensation:** $180K to $250K base

### **About the Company**

Our client is a well-funded, early-stage company backed by top-tier investors, building an ad network designed for AI-native products. Traditional banner and video ads do not work inside conversational interfaces, so they have built ad formats and targeting made for GenAI environments: publishers monetize free users without hurting the experience, and advertisers reach high-intent users one-to-one. The team is small, scrappy and builder-focused, with strong ties to the indie developer and founder community.

Founded 2024 · ~20 people · Industry: Ad Tech, AI, Marketing

### **The Role**

You would join a backend engineering team of five to six people as the sixth or seventh engineer. The work is broad and ownership is high: you take ambiguous business problems, such as improving return on ad spend, break them into projects you lead, and ship them. The core systems are a real-time auction and ad-decisioning pipeline, the data models underneath it, and the abstractions that define what an ad can be inside a conversation.

**What you'll be doing**

* Ship foundational backend code and own production services from design through operation
* Build and evolve relational data models and schemas for transactional systems
* Design the abstractions behind new ad formats for conversational AI
* Improve the real-time auction and ad-selection systems that drive publisher revenue
* Work across the stack where needed; there is no rigid team split

**Tech stack:** Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Kafka, Python, TypeScript, React, Terraform, AWS, Tailscale, Cloudflare

### **Requirements**

* A track record of owning backend services end to end, having carried them through the full development lifecycle more than once
* At least 3 years as a backend engineer, with the kind of production ownership typically found at the senior level
* Solid relational data modeling and schema design on transactional databases, with strong SQL and the ability to debug data issues
* Hands-on experience with some combination of Ruby on Rails, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, React and TypeScript
* Exposure to analytics or OLAP databases (ClickHouse or similar) or infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform
* Comfort operating on AWS with a modern observability setup (Grafana-family tooling or similar)

### **Nice to Haves**

* Time at an early-stage startup, as a founder or an early engineer
* Background in ad tech, real-time bidding or auction systems, or low-latency work at a trading firm
* A degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field

### **Why Join**

* Build core infrastructure for how AI products get monetized, at a company with significant funding and top-tier backing
* Join a small, highly experienced engineering team that moves fast and values craft
* Own foundational systems with real autonomy rather than a narrow slice
* Work on hard, low-latency problems whose impact shows up directly in customer revenue

### **Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco, CA
* **Work policy:** Hybrid, roughly four days a week in the San Francisco office
* **Compensation:** $180K to $250K base
* **Visa sponsorship:** Available, including visa transfers (OPT, H-1B) and new sponsorship (H-1B, TN)
* **Employment type:** Full-time

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
description:
Olive Systems partners with fast-growing AI and technology companies across the United States to help them build and scale their engineering teams.

We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real-world technical solutions.

Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies.

Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies.

**This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.**

**What You’ll Do**

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements.

Your responsibilities may include:

* Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions.
* Designing, developing, and deploying production-ready applications and systems.
* Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products.
* Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies.
* Making architectural and technical decisions independently.
* Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities.
* Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment.

**Who We’re Looking For**

We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently.

You might currently be a:

* Forward Deployed Engineer
* Senior / Staff Full-Stack Engineer
* Founding Engineer or Technical Founder
* AI / Applied AI Engineer
* Solutions Architect with hands-on development experience
* Senior Software Engineer with end-to-end product ownership

**What matters most:**

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience.
* Proven track record of building and shipping production systems.
* Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish.
* Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade-offs.
* Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements.
* Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience building AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Background in early-stage startups or fast-paced product environments.
* Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers.
* Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations.

**Our Hiring Process**

**1. Initial Technical Evaluation**

We’ll invite you to a short AI-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience.

We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems.

No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions.

**2. Conversation with Olive Systems**

We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability.

**3. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities**

When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps.

Depending on the company, additional technical interviews or assessments may be required.

**Location & Work Setup**

We work with technology companies hiring across the **United States**.

Opportunities may be fully remote, hybrid, or onsite, depending on the company.

Specific location, compensation, employment arrangements, and work authorization or sponsorship requirements vary by opportunity.

**Why Join Our Network?**

Instead of applying to multiple companies individually, you can complete our initial evaluation once and be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available.

Our goal is to connect experienced engineers with companies where their technical expertise, problem-solving abilities, and career ambitions are a strong match.

**Interested?**

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile.

If your experience aligns with what our partner companies are looking for, we’ll contact you with the next steps.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

As a Senior Program Manager, PMO, you will own program management for Juniper Square’s most complex, cross-functional software initiatives, driving execution from planning through release while acting as a senior voice inside our Program Management Office (PMO). You will partner closely with engineering, product, design, QA, platform, and operations leadership to build program plans, resolve dependencies, and keep delivery on track against customer commitments. You will act as a bridge between engineering, product management, and other cross-functional partners, translating ambiguous, high-stakes problems into a program plan that accounts for internal and external dependencies.

Beyond your own programs, you will help set the standard for how the PMO runs: contributing to governance, process standardization, metrics, and, critically, how the team uses AI. This role carries a heavy AI focus. You are expected to operate at the Workflow Orchestrator level on Juniper Square’s AI fluency ladder. That means you do not just use AI tools yourself; you design and deploy multi-step workflows that span multiple tools or data sources and replace manual coordination, and you build the reusable systems (prompt libraries, Cowork skills and plugins, scripted Jira/Confluence data extraction) that other program and technical program managers across the org rely on. You will be looked to as the AI thought leader for the PMO organization, actively raising the AI fluency floor for the team.

What you’ll do

  • Own program management for Juniper Square’s most complex, multi-team software initiatives, partnering with engineering, product, design, QA, platform, and operations to build program plans, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and drive execution through every stage of the software development lifecycle.

  • Act as a senior bridge between engineering and product management, translating ambiguous, cross-functional problems into a concrete program plan with clear milestones, owners, and dependencies, including with third-party teams where relevant.

  • Establish and evolve the execution framework (agile/scrum ceremonies, artifacts, governance cadence) for your programs, and contribute those improvements back into PMO-wide standards and processes.

  • Provide regular, senior-leadership-ready status reporting; proactively identify, monitor, and mitigate risk; apply change management discipline when scope or timelines shift.

  • Contribute to PMO governance, including metrics definitions, process standardization, and adherence tracking, across the broader program management team.

  • Design and deploy multi-step, AI-powered workflows, such as Cowork skills and plugins and scripted Jira/Confluence extraction and analysis, that replace manual PMO coordination, built as systems other PMs and TPMs can reuse rather than one-off personal shortcuts.

  • Maintain a working library of reusable prompts, templates, and automations for high-frequency PMO work (status reporting, metrics dashboards, roadmap artifacts) and proactively share them across the team.

  • Serve as an AI thought leader for the PMO org: define what “good” looks like before automating a workflow, build in validation steps, and own the accuracy of anything you ship. You can delegate the work, never the accountability.

  • Mentor and coach TPMs and PMs on day-to-day program management practice, PMO goals, and their own AI fluency; contribute to roadmap planning and help anticipate delivery challenges across the organization.

  • Ensure program documentation, status reporting, and delivery metrics are maintained on a regular, reliable cadence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • 15+ years of total industry experience, including 8+ years of technical program management on complex, large programs spanning multiple cross-functional teams.

  • Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle and technical program management at scale, with a track record of driving programs from concept through release across multiple teams.

  • Demonstrated AI fluency at the Workflow Orchestrator level: you have designed and deployed at least one multi-step AI or Cowork workflow spanning multiple tools or data sources, with a measurable time or quality improvement you can speak to specifically. Not just personal, ad hoc prompting.

  • Comfortable maintaining a working library of reusable prompts, skills, or workflow templates, and configuring Cowork skills, connectors, and plugins without needing engineering support.

  • Hands-on experience automating program-management workflows with AI, for example scripting or using AI tools to extract and analyze data from Jira and Confluence, generate status reports, or build reusable prompt libraries and templates that others rely on.

  • Comfort defining quality criteria before deploying AI-assisted workflows, validating outputs, and owning the accuracy of anything you automate.

  • Experience with project management tooling (Atlassian suite, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent) and Agile/Scrum; working familiarity with SAFe.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with product management, design and UX, customer success, customer support, and other functions such as sales, marketing, and legal as needed.

  • Experience with program and project governance: budgeting, vendor management, compliance, and metrics.

  • Professional credentials (PMI PMP, ACP, CSM) a plus.

  • Experience with fintech platforms, cloud platforms (AWS), Docker, and Kubernetes a plus.

  • Self-driven and adaptable, comfortable mentoring peers, and flexible working with counterparts across geographies and time zones.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary and equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $190,000 USD. The Canadian base salary range for this role is $120,000 to $150,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

title: Mobile Engineer - React Native (Paris or Remote France)
description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.

Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.

Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.

In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.

This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre, Engineering Manager.

This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France.

💼 About the job

  • Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers.
  • Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage.
  • Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements.
  • Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes.

🧰 You will work with

  • Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules.
  • Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro.
  • Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs.
  • Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature.
  • Back-end: Python, FastAPI.
  • Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude.

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript, with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play.
  • You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching.
  • You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment.

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications.
  • Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale.
  • Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome.
  • Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development.

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme.
  • Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage.
  • Use a modern mobile stack based on Expo 57, React Native’s New Architecture, React 19, TypeScript 7, Reanimated 4 and Nitro modules.

  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan

  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

  • Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
  • Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace
  • Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

NetDocuments is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the next generation of our document management platform. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who brings deep expertise building production-grade full stack applications and a strong track record of leading technical direction within their team.

You’ll operate as a hands-on technical leader, helping drive the architecture and delivery of scalable, event-driven systems across React, TypeScript, Node.js, C#/.NET, and AWS. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Platform Services, and engineering leadership to solve complex technical challenges, integrate emerging technologies including AI-powered services, and ensure our platform continues to scale with the performance, reliability, and security our customers expect.

You will:

Technical Leadership & Team Impact

  • Serve as a hands-on technical leader, helping define technical direction and engineering standards across the team.

  • Lead architectural discussions and make technical decisions across frontend, backend, and distributed systems.

  • Establish patterns for building scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable applications.

  • Guide the evolution of the technology stack as the platform matures and scales.

  • Drive technical initiatives that improve system performance, reliability, developer experience, and engineering quality.

Design & Build

  • Architect and build production-grade full stack applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, C#/.NET, and AWS.

  • Design and implement event-driven architectures using AWS services, Kafka, and modern data pipelines.

  • Build responsive frontend experiences that make complex document management workflows intuitive and efficient.

  • Design scalable REST and GraphQL APIs that power product experiences and third-party integrations.

  • Build content enrichment and search capabilities that surface insights across large volumes of documents.

  • Integrate AI-powered services and emerging technologies that enhance document intelligence and user productivity.

System Performance & Operational Excellence

  • Design resilient systems that maintain reliability and performance as the platform scales globally.

  • Instrument applications with logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and telemetry to proactively identify and diagnose issues.

  • Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement improvements to scalability and reliability.

  • Ensure security, performance, and compliance requirements are incorporated throughout system design and implementation.

  • Proactively identify and address technical debt across the platform.

Problem Solving & Ownership

  • Own complex technical initiatives from initial design through production deployment and ongoing evolution.

  • Solve challenges across areas such as real-time search, event-driven document processing, frontend performance, and distributed systems.

  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs across performance, usability, security, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Create clear technical documentation, including architectural diagrams, system designs, and key technical decisions.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Partner closely with Product and Design to translate customer and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Mentor engineers across experience levels and help elevate technical capabilities and engineering practices across the team.

  • Collaborate with Platform Services and other engineering teams on shared infrastructure and integration points.

  • Build alignment around technical approaches and provide clear direction when decisions need to be made.

  • Lead knowledge sharing through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and hands-on technical guidance.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

  • Stay current with modern full stack development, cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and AI-powered technologies.

  • Research and validate emerging technologies through proof-of-concepts aligned with product and engineering strategy.

  • Identify opportunities to improve both customer experience and engineering velocity.

  • Leverage modern development and AI tooling to increase engineering effectiveness and impact.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade applications at scale.

  • 3+ years of experience providing technical leadership and influencing engineering direction and practices.

Your Role:

As an AI Security Engineer on Tenable's Information Security team, you will help shape and mature our approach to securing AI both within Tenable's products and across the enterprise. AI introduces a new class of risk at the intersection of application security, cloud risk, and data governance, and you will be on the front lines of defining how we assess, test, and address it.

You will apply hands-on AI engineering experience alongside deep product security and application security skills to design security controls for AI systems, lead assessments, and help engineering teams ship AI features securely. You will establish security standards for responsible AI use, influence decisions across the organization, and build tooling that raises our security posture.

This role is ideal for a practitioner who has spent real time building with AI systems, looking under the hood of model internals, and wants to channel that experience into a security specialty.

Your Opportunity:

  • Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end security controls across the AI/ML lifecycle.
  • Conduct safety research, inspecting model internals (e.g., detecting hidden deception, latent knowledge, or unwanted concepts across layers) as a core methodology.
  • Perform AI safety assessments and threat modeling for AI/ML systems, identifying risks such as data poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, adversarial inputs, and integrity attacks.
  • Design and implement robust security guardrails, controls, and boundary mechanisms for Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open-source models.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in AI safety research by inspecting model internals to detect hidden deception, latent knowledge, or unwanted concepts, ensuring highly transparent and aligned AI outputs.
  • Continuously monitor the AI landscape for novel vulnerabilities and attack techniques, applying deep engineering experience to proactively defend enterprise AI deployments.
  • Develop security reference architectures for AI deployment patterns, including MCP servers and agentic AI workflows and harnesses.
  • Deploy controls to ensure model integrity, governance, and proper access control across models and feature stores.
  • Build AI-driven tooling to strengthen cybersecurity posture across identity, incident management, vulnerability management, third-party risk, and emerging AI threat vectors.
  • Perform AI safety, security assessments, threat modeling for AI/ML systems, identifying risks such as data poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, adversarial inputs, and integrity attacks.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, and product teams to integrate security best practices into AI development, training, validation, and deployment processes.
  • Drive Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices for AI-powered products, including threat modeling, security testing, penetration testing, and CI/CD pipeline security automation.
  • Create security guidance, documentation, and training for internal engineering and development teams; develop metrics that drive desired security behaviors and outcomes.
  • Research emerging trends in AI security and contribute to innovative solutions that support Tenable's AI initiatives.

What You'll Need:

  • 5 or more years of professional experience in information security or application security, with at least 1–2 years focused on securing AI/ML systems.
  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field preferred; advanced degree preferred.
  • Deep understanding of AI-specific security threats, including adversarial ML, data poisoning, prompt injection, model inversion, model evasion, and inference attacks.
  • Strong coding experience in Python and/or Go.
  • Experience with frameworks & libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow or similar.
  • Experience using specialized interpretability and probing tools/libraries such as TransformerLens, NNsight, Captum, or LIT (Learning Interpretability Tool).
  • Familiarity with mechanistic & Architectural Concepts: inspecting internal model states, residual streams, attention patterns, activation steering, Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), or feature attribution.
  • Strong understanding of the ML/AI lifecycle and the security risks associated with each stage.
  • Knowledge of cloud security platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP including AI/ML-related services.
  • Knowledge of data security principles, including encryption, masking, and tokenization.
  • Knowledge of SSDLC, DevSecOps, and security testing practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and threat modeling.
  • Knowledge of application security architecture best practices and patterns, including modern web applications, Docker, and microservices.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across engineering, product, and business teams.
  • Strong written and verbal comAAmunication skills; able to clearly translate complex AI security risks for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to lead projects with end-to-end ownership.
  • Self-motivated and effective working independently and across distributed teams.

And Ideally:

  • Hands-on experience with AI red teaming, adversarial prompt testing, or LLM security assessments.
  • Familiarity of AI security frameworks and standards, including OWASP LLM Top 10 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Experience with application security assessment tools (Burp Suite, ZAP, Tenable WAS, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, etc.).
  • Background in cloud security or large-scale SaaS product environments.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

  • Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

  • Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

  • Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

  • Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

  • Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

  • Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments

  • Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

  • Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3

  • Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems

  • Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification

  • Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

  • Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints

  • Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment

  • Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks

  • Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

Perks/Benefits

  • Competitive base compensation

  • Annual bonus potential

  • Health benefits effective on start date

  • Health & Wellness Program; up to $300 per quarter for your overall well-being available on start date

  • 401K plan effective on the first of the month after your start date; 100% of up to 4% of your annual salary

  • Unlimited (or generous) paid "Vytal Time", and 5 paid sick days after your first 90 days

  • Company paid STD/LTD

  • Technology setup

  • Ability to help build a market leader in value-based healthcare at a rapidly growing organization

Please note at no time during our screening, interview, or selection process do we ask for additional personal information (beyond your resume) or account/financial information. We will also never ask for you to purchase anything; nor will we ever interview you via text message.
